_note: Predictive Sandbox R&D content. Family: collision. Texture: two distinct, unyielding forces meeting. Agendas clashing, deadlines hitting at the same time. Routes heavily on semantic_state=opposed, gradient, and lifecycle_route.

entries.title: A Standstill at the Peak
entries.body: The competing pressures have reached their highest recorded level, and neither side is giving way. This is not a sudden accident, but the predictable culmination of two opposing tracks finally hitting the same space. Expect a locked grid where raw force won't easily resolve the issue.
entries.notes: opposed + plateau + culminating: the heaviest possible conflict holding at the peak.

entries.title: An Emergent Clash of Priorities
entries.body: Two separate forces have abruptly entered the same lane. Because this is an emergent window, there is no existing protocol or prior episode to rely on. The conflict is fresh and the impact is immediate, demanding rapid triage rather than a pre-planned response.

entries.title: Sustaining Two Incompatible Directives
entries.body: The dominant pressure is to sustain, but the semantic state is fiercely opposed. This usually looks like an institution or system trying to maintain two contradictory rules or commitments at the same time. The structure is holding, but the internal shear force is massive.
entries.notes: opposed + sustain: holding onto conflict rather than resolving it.

entries.title: The Pressure of the Collision Recedes
entries.body: The forces are still fundamentally opposed, but the immediate crisis of their meeting is starting to pass. The gradient is releasing, meaning the hardest part of the collision has occurred and the involved parties are beginning to separate or step down from red alert.
